N01:
theorem N01 {D : Type*} [AddCommGroup D] (X L H : D) (h : H + (L - X) = X) :
    H = X + X - L
N02:
theorem N02 {D : Type*} [AddCommGroup D] (X L : D) :
    (X + X - (X + X - L) = L) ∧ ((X + X - L) + (L - X) + (L - X) = L)
N03:
theorem N03 (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c) (f : E → EReal) :
    F c⁻¹ (F c f) = f
N04:
theorem N04 (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c) (f : E → EReal) (hf : Q f) :
    Q (F c f)
N05:
theorem N05 (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c) (f : E → EReal) (hf : Q f) (y g : E) (hg : g ∈ S f (c • y)) :
    c • g ∈ S (F c f) y
N06:
theorem N06 (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c) (f : E → EReal) (hf : B f) :
    B (F c f)
N07:
theorem N07 (c : ℝ) (f : E → ℝ) (y g : E) (hf : HasGradientAt f g (c • y)) :
    HasGradientAt (fun z => f (c • z)) (c • g) y
N08:
theorem N08 (c : ℝ) (f : E → ℝ) (y : E) (hf : DifferentiableAt ℝ f (c • y)) :
    gradient (fun z => f (c • z)) y = c • gradient f (c • y)
N09:
theorem N09 (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c) (η : ℝ) (x g : E) :
    c⁻¹ • (x - η • g) = c⁻¹ • x - (η / c ^ 2) • (c • g)
N10:
theorem N10 (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c) (η : ℝ) (x g : E) :
    c • (c⁻¹ • x - η • (c • g)) = x - (c ^ 2 * η) • g
N11:
theorem N11 (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c) (η : ℕ → ℝ) (t : ℕ) (hη : 0 < η t) :
    0 < e c η t
N12:
theorem N12 (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c) (η : ℕ → ℝ) (loss : ℕ → E → EReal) (x₁ : E) (p : P (E := E)) (t : ℕ) :
    H K (e c η) (fun s => F c (loss s)) (c⁻¹ • x₁) (a c p) t = fun i => c⁻¹ • H K η loss x₁ p t i
N13:
theorem N13 (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c) (η : ℕ → ℝ) (loss : ℕ → E → EReal) (x₁ : E) (p : P (E := E)) (t : ℕ) :
    Z K (e c η) (fun s => F c (loss s)) (c⁻¹ • x₁) (a c p) t = c⁻¹ • Z K η loss x₁ p t
N14:
theorem N14 (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c) (η : ℕ → ℝ) (loss : ℕ → E → EReal) (x₁ : E) (p : P (E := E)) (t : ℕ) :
    G K (e c η) (fun s => F c (loss s)) (c⁻¹ • x₁) (a c p) t = c • G K η loss x₁ p t
N15:
theorem N15 (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c) (η : ℕ → ℝ) (loss : ℕ → E → EReal) (x₁ : E) (p : P (E := E)) (T : ℕ) (hproper : ∀ t < T, Q (loss t)) (hlegal : L K η loss x₁ p T) :
    L K (e c η) (fun s => F c (loss s)) (c⁻¹ • x₁) (a c p) T
N16:
theorem N16 (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c) (η : ℕ → ℝ) (loss : ℕ → E → EReal) (x₁ : E) (p : P (E := E)) (t : ℕ) :
    F c (loss t) (Z K (e c η) (fun s => F c (loss s)) (c⁻¹ • x₁) (a c p) t) = loss t (Z K η loss x₁ p t)
N17:
theorem N17 (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c) (η : ℕ → ℝ) (loss : ℕ → E → EReal) (x₁ : E) (p : P (E := E)) (u : E) (T : ℕ) :
    R K (e c η) (fun s => F c (loss s)) (c⁻¹ • x₁) (a c p) (c⁻¹ • u) T = R K η loss x₁ p u T
N18:
theorem N18 (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c) (η : ℕ → ℝ) (loss : ℕ → E → EReal) (x₁ : E) (p : P (E := E)) (t : ℕ) :
    c • Z K η (fun s => F c (loss s)) (c⁻¹ • x₁) (a c p) t = Z K (fun s => c ^ 2 * η s) loss x₁ p t
N19:
theorem N19 (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c) (x u : E) :
    ‖c⁻¹ • x - c⁻¹ • u‖ ^ 2 = ‖x - u‖ ^ 2 / c ^ 2
N20:
theorem N20 (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c) (η : ℕ → ℝ) (loss : ℕ → E → EReal) (x₁ : E) (p : P (E := E)) (T : ℕ) :
    (∑ t ∈ range T, ‖G K (e c η) (fun s => F c (loss s)) (c⁻¹ • x₁) (a c p) t‖ ^ 2) = c ^ 2 * (∑ t ∈ range T, ‖G K η loss x₁ p t‖ ^ 2)
N21:
theorem N21 (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c) (A B η : ℝ) (hη : 0 < η) :
    U (A / c ^ 2) (c ^ 2 * B) (η / c ^ 2) = U A B η
N22:
theorem N22 (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c) (η : ℝ) (hη : 0 < η) (loss : ℕ → E → EReal) (x₁ : E) (p : P (E := E)) (T : ℕ) (hloss : ∀ t < T, B (loss t)) (hlegal : L K (fun _ => η) loss x₁ p T) (u : E) :
    R K (e c (fun _ => η)) (fun s => F c (loss s)) (c⁻¹ • x₁) (a c p) (c⁻¹ • u) T ≤ ‖x₁ - u‖ ^ 2 / (2 * η) + η / 2 * (∑ t ∈ range T, ‖G K (fun _ => η) loss x₁ p t‖ ^ 2) - ‖Z K (fun _ => η) loss x₁ p T - u‖ ^ 2 / (2 * η)
